text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Kaori and {0} have finished
clearing up the venue following the end of the dance party.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ダンスパーティの終了後、
{0}とカオリは会場の片づけを終えた。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! This feels great!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ～
気持ちいいさ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Come on over, {0}! ♪
The sea's a little bit chilly at night,
but it's the perfect way to cool down after all that dancing! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}もおいでよ～♪
夜の海は冷たいけど、
踊ったあとの体には
ちょうどいいさ～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
You don't have a swimsuit, so you can't?
Oh. I guess I didn't give you any time to prepare, did I?
Sorry about that. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
水着を持ってきてないからダメ？
そういえば、
何の準備もしないまま連れてきちゃったんだよね～
ごめんね～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Swish, swish. ♪
Swimming really does feel nice. What a great day!
I got to play the sanshin, dance a bunch and even swim. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ざぶざぶ～
っと♪
やっぱり泳ぐのは気持ちいいさ～♪
三線弾いて、
踊って泳いで、
いい一日だったよね～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Hm? My chest feels a bit chilly.
I think the cold might be getting to me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん～？　
何だか胸の辺りがス～ス～するさ～？
体が冷えてきちゃったのかな～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to keep {0} waiting, either,
so I guess I should go back to shore.
Whoa?! Why's the sea so bright all of a sudden?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}を待たせるのも悪いし、
そろそろ上がらないとね～
って、
何だか海が明るいさ～！？

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: What a lively tune!
text_block_list.orig_text: 何てご機嫌な曲なんだ！

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
For real!
It's making me want to dance! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほんとね、
踊っちゃおうかしら♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Is that...?
It is! {0}!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ～？
　
そこにいるのは……
あ～！　
{0}！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Haitai!
Didn't think I'd bump into you here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハイタ～イ♪
まさか{0}と会えるなんて思わなかったさ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Me? We're holding a training camp for the upcoming karate competition. ♪
Today's an off day, though, so I'm here to perform. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
私？　
空手の大会前の強化合宿さ～♪
今日はお休みだから、
こうして弾き語りしてるんだよ～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: You might as well listen now that you're here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
会えた記念に、
{0}も聴いていくさ～！

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Is that your boyfriend?
Then you gotta play for him up close!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっ、
何だい、
嬢ちゃんの彼氏かい？
だったら目の前で聴いてあげなよ！

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: Heehee. He's got the best seat in the house.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うふふ。
彼だけの特等席ね♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: What do they mean by \"boyfriend\"?
choice_data_list: That we like each other, I guess?
text_block_list.orig_text:
彼氏、
って何のことさ～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
L-lovers?!
That's not true at all! Right?
Now I'm feeling all embarrassed.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
恋人～！？
私と{0}はそんなんじゃない、
よね～？
何か、
恥ずかしくなってきたさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Well...
I [i]do[/i] like you, but not in a weird way, y'know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
好きな人……
{0}のことは好きだけど、
そういうことじゃないさ～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Uh...
I guess I'll play, then.
text_block_list.orig_text:
え～と
じゃあ、
演奏するさ～

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: Hm? The melody's a lot different now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
さっきとは
曲調が変わったな……

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
It's nice and soothing, though.
I like it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
これはこれで落ち着いてて、
いい感じね……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
This is weird.
I can't play the same way I did a minute ago...
text_block_list.orig_text:
おかしいさ～
さっきまでみたいな演奏が
できなくなっちゃったさ～……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: {0} is staring right at me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}、
すごく真剣な目でこっち見てるさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
This is so weird! I'm feeling all flushed, too...
Did I say out in the sunlight too long?
text_block_list.orig_text:
で～じ変だよ～、
顔が熱っぽいさ～……
てぃーだの日差しに当たりすぎたかな～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
...!
I know what to do at times like this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
！
そうさ～！　
こういう時は！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Can you hold this for me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっとこれ、
持っててほしいさ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Wahoooo! ☆
text_block_list.orig_text: きゃっほ～☆

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text:
Whoa.
She just went and dove into the water...
text_block_list.orig_text:
おいあの子、
急に海に飛び込んでいっちゃったぞ……

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: And now she's swimming like her life depends on it...
text_block_list.orig_text: すごい勢いで泳いでるわ……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Phew! I needed that!
But now my clothes're all soaked.
Off they go! ☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅ～
スッキリしたさ～！
服がずぶぬれになっちゃったね～、
よいしょっと☆

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Aha! Don't worry!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはー、
大丈夫さ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: I had my swimsuit on underneath! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
下に水着、
着てるからね～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
I feel great now that I've cooled off!
Now to perform some more!
text_block_list.orig_text:
海でひんやりして、
気分スッキリさ～！
じゃあ、
演奏の続きさ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I should dry myself off with this?
You really are super thoughtful! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
これで拭けって？
{0}はほんとに気配りの達人だね～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Wipey-wipe. ☆
Okay! Here I go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
拭き拭き～
っと☆
じゃあ
行っくさ～！

text_block_list.name: Man
text_block_list.text: Oh! Here's another lively tune!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっ、
こりゃまた明るい曲だな！

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I can't contain it.
I'm gonna dance! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう我慢できないわ、
踊っちゃいましょ♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Music really does put everyone on the same wavelength.
I love it! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱり
音楽はみんな一つになれて最高さ～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: My face still feels a bit flushed even after cooling myself off, though.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
海で頭は冷やしたのに、
まだちょっと顔が熱いさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: It only started after he showed up.
text_block_list.orig_text: {0}が来てからだよね～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: I wonder why?
text_block_list.orig_text: 何でだろ～？

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What're you looking at?
You can't blame me for humming along to her tune, can you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
何見てるのよ。
カオリちゃんの演奏が心地よかったから、
つい口ずさんじゃっただけよ。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Feelings are in the music, and music's in the feelings.
That's a wonderful saying, isn't it? Seems like her feelings have
undergone a little change, too. Did you notice?
text_block_list.orig_text:
音楽は気持ちだって、
いい言葉よね。
そんなカオリちゃんも
少しだけ気持ちの変化があったみたい。
あんたには分かったかしら？

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Not that you'll remember any of this dream, though.
But if anything can make up for that, it's music.
text_block_list.orig_text:
とはいえこれは夢だから、
すぐに忘れちゃうと思うけど。
音楽の中に、
残るものはあるかもしれないわね。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, see you arou—
Actually, hold up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃ、
ばいば……
あ、
ちょっと待った！

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Close your eyes the second you wake up, okay?!
You won't remember me saying this, but just make sure you do!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんた、
戻ったらすぐに目を閉じなさいよ！
覚えてないかもしれないけど、
絶対よ？

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Okay. I'll let you go for real now.
Catch you later. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃ今度こそ、
またね♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Mmm... Did I fall asleep on the beach?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん～？　
砂浜で寝ちゃってたさ～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Is this a cape?
Did you drape it over me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？
　
これ、マント？
{0}がかけてくれたの～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: I'd catch a cold if I slept like that, so thanks! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
そのまま寝てたら
風邪ひいちゃうもんね～♪
ありがとうさ～♪

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Hm? That's not why you did it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
違う？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, right.
My swimsuit slipped off.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ～、
なるほど。
水着が外れちゃってたんだね～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
You didn't see anything?
Aha! I wouldn't have cared if you did.
text_block_list.orig_text:
見てないから？
あは～、
別に見られても平気だよ～？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
My heart's kind of racing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あれ？
何か胸がドキドキするさ～

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Feels like I could play an entirely new melody now.
I might be able to discover all kinds of music if I'm with him. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
今なら、
また違う音色で弾けそうだよ～
{0}といると、
いろんな音楽が見つかるね～♪
